title: Bracken Terrace
description: A lilting concertino in nine-eight trades a wide singing melody for a rippling lower part. Chordal refrains briefly gather the voices together; a darker solo episode then dissolves into a quick shared cadenza. The last refrain is brighter and shorter than the first.
technical_note: Feel three large pulses in each bar. Keep the lower arpeggios light beneath the melody and retain their direction through changes of hand position. The alternating cadenza needs matched tone and precise rests rather than overlapping pedal.

performance.note: Authored breathing, changing dialogue and independent voicing; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
